This is the change log:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Improvement: added video tutorial for the blueprints window, visible when no blueprints exist in the library[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: fixed bug where blueprints would not be correctly loaded[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: building a road out of town after changing market configuration would not correctly set the market configuration[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: minimap color palette changed to improve resource visibility[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: log scrolling corrected[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: building placement rotation may fail in some cases[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: improved translations[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: truck depot added as a destination in the truck list window[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: fixed window resizing on blueprints menu[/p][/*][*][p]Improved: shortcuts for window management[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo update notes for v0.35
notes.content: [p]Truck City v0.35-Demo has just been released. This change log also includes changes in hotfixes 0.34.1 and 0.34.2. This is the change log:[/p][list][*][p]Improvement: Upgraded Godot engine to version 4.5[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: First run sped up, the game now includes pre-compiled shaders (20% speed-up)[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: minimap colors improved to make factories and resources much more visible, visually appealing[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: added level of detail models for containers; makes GPU frame time approximately 10% faster in very factories with far away zoom[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: updated tileset for Oil and Space DEMO map, especially for one way roads[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: performance improvements when using blueprints[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: blueprints system may not save blueprints used by the user, corrected[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: "Map never completed" may show in the objectives menu after completing a map and selecting to stay in the map[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: one way roads in blueprints occasionally may not be correctly built[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: rarely blueprints may be built on top of resources, other buildings, or out of bounds, fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: some blueprints may print "unable to build this blueprint" after building it[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Camera angle changed, camera transition changed[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: better translations for leaderboards[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: improved look and feel of Leaderboards window[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improvement: added button to go to my rank in Leaderboards window[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: corrected tilemap for 2-tile production buildings next to loading ports[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Truck depot now shows information regarding incoming trucks and occupied and total parking spots[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Added encryption for records file, hopefully preventing or reducing cheating[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: other anti-cheating measures taken to prevent custom maps to inject results on official map leaderboards[/p][/*][*][p]Balance: changed default traffic light duration to 5s (from 10s)[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: factory window will show a cleaner interface at the frame it's loaded (previously might show outdated information)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bugfix: trucks would select a truck depot by distance, disregarding priority[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: changed default shortcut for blueprints menu to Control+B instead of B, so the window can be closed using the same shortcut without interfering with the user typing[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: blueprints with one way roads were not correctly updating the minimap when built[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: manually despawned trucks would still show their route on the map, removed[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: one way tiles changed so right side of the road shows yellow marks and left side shows white marks (as is usually the case in reality)[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: clicking on log messages may also trigger clicks below the log too[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: road menu items may be reverse cycled using the Shift+2 shortcut[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Key mapping menu sorted by function key[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Added translation for market menu[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Removed incorrect tooltip text in global menu[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: Information tooltip text window now resets when scrolling or zooming[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bugfix: corrected warning message in factory tooltip text regarding amount of outbound warehouses[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo update notes for v0.34
notes.content: [p]Truck City v0.34-Demo has just been released. This is the change log:[/p][list][*][p]Feature: Trucks list window now allows sorting by column[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bugfix: roundabouts and blueprints including one-way roads now correctly set the road direction[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: camera will be completely top-down (90º) when it's far from the ground[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: factory rounding error that might cause uneven production ratios corrected[/p][/*][*][p]Balance: lowered production speed for rocket launchpads[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: user interface cleanup[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: other minor UI improvements such as faster scrolling in science menu, better placement for loading port menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: traffic light duration defaults to 5, limited to 99 seconds.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 🚚 Truck City – First Playable Demo Coming Early September!
notes.content: [p]The very first demo of [i]Truck City[/i] will hit the Steam Store in early September! Add the game to your wishlist now to stay updated on all future releases and content drops.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45672321/74da82e9a4795b6f307242096a295129178cff64.png"][/img][/p][h3]What’s included in the demo:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Tutorial maps[/b] to introduce the core mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Exclusive demo map[/b] that drops you right into the mid-game, letting you experience the full range of systems: research, market dynamics, management, and construction.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leaderboards[/b] so you can challenge your friends and climb the ranks.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]What’s waiting in the full game:[/h3][p]The demo gives you a taste, but the full version will feature much more, including:[/p][list][*][p][b]Mission Mode[/b] – face unique challenges and race against the clock.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sandbox Mode[/b] – generate custom maps of any size and resource richness, then play without limits, setting your own objectives.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom Maps via Steam Workshop[/b] – explore community-made creations or share your own.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Truck City playtest is now ready!
notes.content: [p]Truck City Playtest has just been released and is welcoming players to evaluate strong and weak points, test playability, look for bugs, and provide feedback! This is the first playable version of Truck City ever released, so bugs are to be expected.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45672321/571046e58c1d5e61c0e29e2ea930ef38e3f8b524.png"][/img][/p][p]We have [url="https://forms.gle/cputvcmYwrsELc7YA"]prepared a form[/url] that is automatically opened when the game is closed so you can provide your feedback, but if you prefer it you can email [url="https://feedback@truckcitygame.com"]feedback@truckcitygame.com[/url] with your comments. The game does not collect any information from your gameplay, so reporting your experience is crucial for the testing to be successful![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45672321/b97b2eb376bc3e9497a4210816067f112a680307.png"][/img]Thank you![/p]
